ios.desc:
The best Ethereum gas fee & Bitcoin fees widget app

Ethereum Gas Fee Widget and All Essential Crypto Analytics.

Introducing the Crypto Widget Toolkit - the ultimate tool for crypto enthusiasts and traders! With this app, you can easily add widgets to your iPhone's Home Screen and Lock Screen to keep track of Ethereum gas fees, prices, and more. 

The app's widgets allow you to quickly and conveniently view real-time data on the Ethereum network, including the current gas fees and price. You can also see which blockchain is making the most money at any given time.

With the Crypto Widget app, you'll have all the information you need to make informed decisions about your cryptocurrency investments, right at your fingertips. Download it today and take control of your crypto portfolio!

Analytics include: 

- Home Screen widget Ethereum price & gas fee (urgent, fast, slow)
- Lock Screen widget Ethereum price & gas fee (urgent, fast, slow)
- Apple Watch widget Ethereum price & gas fee (urgent, fast, slow)
- Apple Watch widget Bitcoin fees (urgent, fast, slow)
- Apple Watch Total ETH staked
- Home Screen Bitcoin price
- Lock Screen Bitcoin price
- Lock Screen Bitcoin fees
- Home Screen Bitcoin fees
- Home Screen widget the flippening index ETH vs BTC 
- Home Screen widget the Road to 1T
- Home Screen widget Crypto fees 
- Home Screen widget Staking Pools 
- Home Screen widget Staking Pools APY
- Money printer: How much money are protocols paying to grow? 
- Home Screen widget Money printer: How much money are protocols paying to grow? 
- Daily active addresses (ETH, BTC, DOGE)
- Daily transaction count (ETH, BTC, DOGE)
- Bitcoin fees
- eth gas tracker
- Your collectibles
